primary_hypothesis.claim: Random, Evolutionary, Greedy practically equivalent on protected-test RMSE
margin_rationale: ~2.5x the v1 observed arm median gap (~0.0008)
primary_hypothesis.test: paired TOST by (split,seed) cell, alpha=0.05, equivalence iff 90% CI of mean diff within (-delta,+delta)

secondary_hypotheses.H2_anytime_efficiency: arms may differ in best-val vs proposals/unique-trainings/wallclock
secondary_hypotheses.H3_efficiency: arms may differ in duplicate rate / unique trainings
secondary_hypotheses.H4_quantum_source: trainable entangled VQC > frozen-quantum and product-state
secondary_hypotheses.H5_fair_classical: searched VQC vs fair classical MLP search and analytical estimators

analytical_baselines.A1_argmax: grid position of max normalized input
analytical_baselines.A2_quadratic_peak: parabola through argmax + 2 neighbors; edges fall back to A1
analytical_baselines.A4_gaussian_nlls: per-sample LSQ fit A*exp(-(x-mu)^2/2sig^2)+c, mu in [0,1], sig in [0.005,0.5]; A1 init; failures->A1; never uses true params

quantum_ablations.QF_frozen_random: fixed Q2 arch, quantum angles frozen; 93 trainable + 12 frozen = 105 total
quantum_ablations.QP_product_state: 3 single-qubit rotation layers (RX,RY,RZ all), NO two-qubit gates; 12 trainable quantum, 105 total
quantum_ablations.QE_fixed_entangled: v1 Q1 HEA fixed; 12 trainable quantum, 105 total
quantum_ablations.QR_fixed_random: v1 Q2 fixed random; 12 trainable quantum, 105 total

power_analysis.note: v1 variance is a small-sample estimate; design not revised on favorable scenarios
